description: This file defines the Collapse class and plugin for Bootstrap v3.2.0, implementing collapsible UI components with show, hide, toggle functionalities, and associated event handling.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Class implementing the collapse behavior for Bootstrap components, managing show/hide transitions and state.

methods.name: dimension
methods.description: Determines whether the collapse uses width or height based on the element's classes.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Expands the collapsible element with transition effects.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Collapses the element with transition effects.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states.
